description: Reads project cost data from Excel files, cleans it, writes to Lakehouse table

parameters.name: pLakehouseName
parameters.purpose: Target Lakehouse — swapped per environment via deployment rules

parameters.name: pSourceTable
parameters.purpose: Source table name to read from

parameters.name: pFilterRegion
parameters.purpose: Filter by region — 'ALL' for no filter, or 'EMEA', 'APAC', etc.

notes: Without it, deployment pipelines CANNOT see or override these parameters.
To enable: Home → Options → Parameters → Check 'Enable parameters to be discovered and overridden'
